title: Tupelo Honey
meta_description: Pet Friendly w/ Pool Near Beach & Seaside- Tupelo Honey by Royal Destinations
description_expanded: Description: Tupelo Honey by Royal Destinations Location: Seagrove Beach Address: 19 Cypress Hill Road Details: Tupelo Honey is a welcoming Old Seagrove retreat offering 2,856 square feet of indoor and outdoor living space and accommodations for up to 10 guests. With four bedrooms, three full baths, and one half bath, the home provides plenty of room for families to gather while enjoying one of 30A's most desirable locations. Comfortable living spaces, multiple screened and covered porches, and a fully equipped kitchen create an inviting setting for a relaxed beach vacation. Outside, guests can spend the day beside the private heated pool or take an easy five-minute stroll to the neighborhood beach access. Seaside is just a 90-second walk away, putting its restaurants, shopping, entertainment, and iconic town center within easy reach. Tupelo Honey is also pet friendly for up to two dogs, making it a wonderful option for guests traveling with their four-legged family members. For larger groups, neighboring Moondance can also be rented to provide additional accommodations. If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: -Distance to Beach Access: Approximately 5-Minute Walk -Distance to Seaside: Approximately 90-Second Walk -Parking Spaces: (2) -Dining Accommodations: Table Seating for 8, Bar Seating for 2 -Coffee Maker Available: Drip Coffee Maker and Keurig -Private Heated Pool* -Pet Friendly: Dogs Only, Maximum (2)* -Multiple Screened and Covered Porches -Outdoor Gas Grill *Pool heat is available for an additional $60 (pre-tax) per day. *Pool heating must be arranged prior to arrival. *For pet-friendly stays, breed and weight must be disclosed at booking. Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 10 4 Bedrooms / 3.5 Baths Main Level: -Kitchen / Living Room / Dining Area -Half Bath -Laundry Room -Screened Porch -Covered Porch Second Floor: -Bedroom 1 (Master): King Bed with Private Bath (Walk-In Shower) -Bedroom 2: Queen Bed with Shared Full Bath (Tub/Shower) -Bedroom 3: Queen Bed with Shared Full Bath (Tub/Shower) -Screened Porches Third Floor: -Bedroom 4: (2) Double Beds and Twin Trundle with (2) Twin Beds -Full Bath (Walk-In Shower) *Please Note: Bedroom 4 is an open bedroom without a privacy door. Please Note: *On-street parking is not permitted. Parking is limited to (2) vehicles. *Guests may bring a maximum of (2) dogs. Breed and weight must be disclosed at booking. *Visitors' dogs are not permitted on the beach in Walton County. *Only the living room TV includes local cable. Streaming services are available on Smart TVs using guests' personal login credentials. *The third-floor bedroom is an open sleeping area without a privacy door. *Beach towels are not provided. *Moondance is located next door and may be rented separately for groups needing additional accommodations. *Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
